title: ack_through piggybacked delivery receipts
description: When replying to a sender, include ack_through field set to the highest message ID received from that sender. Track per-sender highest-received-ID. Senders treat ack_through in any reply as equivalent to explicit receipt for all messages with ID <= that value. Zero extra airtime cost. Spec: 12-apps.md §18.1.2 piggybacked receipt. All three impls.
